title: Part-of-term filters disappear from the advanced search DTO

evidence.quote:
return {
    subject: filters.subject,
    number: filters.number,
    instructor: instructorHint ? formatDisplayHintValue(instructorHint, residual) : undefined,
    term: filters.term,
    year: filters.year,
    gened: filters.gened_code ?? (isGenericAnyGenedFilter(filters.gened_any) ? undefined : filters.gened_any?.[0]) ?? filters.gened_all?.[0],
    credits: filters.credits,
    days: filters.days,
    time: filters.time,
    online: filters.online,
    status: filters.status,
    difficulty: filters.difficulty,
    level: filters.level,
  };

reasoning: The DTO supports part-of-term chips and emits a `partOfTerm` filter from hints, but `buildAdvancedState` never copies `filters.partOfTerm` into the returned advanced state. A search plan with an active part-of-term filter will therefore show the chip/filter while the advanced UI state reports no selected part of term.
reproduction: Call `buildSearchUiPlan` with a `partOfTerm` hint and `plan.filters.partOfTerm = 'B'`. The chip filter contains `{ partOfTerm: 'B' }`, but `ui.advanced.partOfTerm` is `undefined`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The search UI tests cover advanced state for subject, number, instructor, difficulty, and GenEd, but none include a `partOfTerm` hint or filter.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a `buildSearchUiPlan` test that passes a `partOfTerm` hint/filter and asserts both the chip filter and `advanced.partOfTerm` are populated.
minimumFixScope: Update `apps/api/src/dto/search-ui.ts` and add one DTO test in `apps/api/src/dto/__tests__/search-ui.test.ts`.
